<\STATESEP>theory ShowTypes_Test
imports
  Lib.ShowTypes
  CParser.LemmaBucket_C
  CParser.CTranslation
begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>experiment
  (* The point of this test is to confirm that the generic 'show types' feature
     shows enough type information to fully reconstruct a term; the pointer type
     feature does something similar so we disable it here. *)
  notes [[show_ptr_types = false]]
begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma c_guard_cast_byte: "c_guard (x :: ('a :: {mem_type}) ptr) \<Longrightarrow> c_guard (ptr_coerce x :: 8 word ptr)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. c_guard x \<Longrightarrow> c_guard (ptr_coerce x)<\STATESEP>goal_show_types 0<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. c_guard x \<Longrightarrow> c_guard (ptr_coerce x)<\STATESEP>using [[show_sorts]]<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. c_guard x \<Longrightarrow> c_guard (ptr_coerce x)
variables:
x :: 'a ptr
type variables:
'a :: mem_type<\STATESEP>goal_show_types 0<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. c_guard x \<Longrightarrow> c_guard (ptr_coerce x)
variables:
x :: 'a ptr
type variables:
'a :: mem_type<\STATESEP>apply (case_tac x)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. \<And>xa::32 word. \<lbrakk>c_guard x; x = Ptr xa\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> c_guard (ptr_coerce x)
variables:
x :: 'a ptr
type variables:
'a :: mem_type<\STATESEP>apply (fastforce intro!: byte_ptr_guarded simp: c_guard_def dest: c_null_guard)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal:
No subgoals!
variables:
x :: 'a ptr
type variables:
'a :: mem_type<\STATESEP>done<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>thm c_guard_cast_byte[where x = "Ptr (ucast (0 :: 8 word))"]<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>thm_show_types c_guard_cast_byte[where x = "Ptr (ucast (0 :: 8 word))"]<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>ML \<open>
  let val ctxt = Config.put show_sorts true @{context}
      (* NB: this test fails if we leave some polymorphism in the term *)
      val term = @{thm c_guard_cast_byte[where x = "Ptr (ucast (0 :: 8 word)) :: unit ptr"]} |> Thm.prop_of
      val string_no_types = Syntax.pretty_term ctxt term
                            |> Pretty.string_of |> YXML.content_of
      val string_show_types = Show_Types.term_show_types true ctxt term

      val _ = assert (Syntax.read_term ctxt string_no_types <> term) "Show_Types test (baseline)"
      val _ = assert (Syntax.read_term ctxt string_show_types = term) "Show_Types test"
  in () end
  \<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>
